title: add-version-pinning-downgrade-guard-backup-restore-schema-migrations-private-installer
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: customers running Redwood Private need safe, predictable upgrades and the ability to rollback in regulated/private environments. This PR implements coordinated version pinning, a downgrade guard, and transactional schema migration/backup-restore hooks for the private installer (Helm + Terraform). Goals: (1) prevent accidental downgrades after a schema migration; (2) provide atomic-ish migration and post-migration verification steps; (3) add improvements to backup/restore tooling used by on-prem operators; (4) surface helpful errors and remediation steps in the installer. Summary of changes: - Add chart-level version pinning and validation at upgrade time. - Add a downgrade-guard controller (configurable via installer values) that blocks rollbacks if migrations are present and no explicit force flag is set. - Introduce transactional migration orchestration: pre-migration backup, migration dry-run, migration apply, post-migration verify (checksum + smoke-tests), and automatic snapshot tagging for backup-restore. - Helm templates: new hooks and annotations for backup/restore and migration lifecycle. - Terraform: provider pinning and module checks to ensure consistent binaries for air-gapped installs. - CLI: --allow-downgrade and --force-rollback flags with audit log entries. Checklist: - [x] Helm templates and hooks implemented - [x] Installer CLI flags and validation added - [x] Migration controller implemented and wired into upgrade path - [x] Backup/restore enhancements with S3/local compatible adapters - [x] End-to-end test harness updates and test cases added - [x] Docs/upgrade notes updated Testing: unit tests for migration controller, integration tests against kind/k3s cluster, helm lint checks, terraform validate, and an on-prem smoke test that runs the full upgrade->verify->rollback scenario. Runbook: added a new upgrade and rollback runbook under docs/private-installer/upgrade-runbook.md with explicit manual steps for operators when automatic verification fails. Note on UX: downgrade blocking is opt-out for existing installs (values.disableDowngradeGuard: true) to avoid breaking older clusters during rollout. See linked Linear items for rollout plan and phased enablement.

release_notes: Adds optional downgrade guard and transactional migration orchestration to the Private Installer. Default behavior keeps existing installs unchanged; operators can opt-in to block downgrades after schema migrations. Implements version pinning for Helm charts and Terraform providers, improves backup/restore snapshot tagging, and includes an upgrade runbook with verification steps.
notes_for_backport: Backport to release/2025-11 needed for customers on the November private installer channel. Backport should exclude helm value schema tightening and keep disableDowngradeGuard default true.
manual_verification_steps: Install private-installer 2025-10 release into a k3s cluster
Run installer upgrade with --dry-run and confirm migration dry-run succeeds
Run installer upgrade and verify post-migration smoke tests pass
Attempt rollback without --force-rollback and confirm downgrade guard blocks the action
Run rollback with --force-rollback and verify restore from snapshot succeeds
